# ES-MoE

> An expert-sparse mixture-of-experts block for convolutional models. A softmax router scores the
> whole image, picks the top-k of several experts whose kernels differ, and mixes their outputs;
> the router's load-balancing term reaches the optimised loss. Native implementations for PyTorch,
> TensorFlow, Jax and Flax, a Keras 3 layer that runs on any of its backends, and a one-call
> integration for Ultralytics YOLO.

Install with `uv add esmoe` for the block, or `uv add esmoe[yolo]`, `esmoe[tensorflow]`,
`esmoe[jax]`, `esmoe[flax]`, `esmoe[keras]` for a framework. Python 3.12 and up, AGPL-3.0-only.

The arguments are the same on every framework: `kernels` gives each expert its receptive field and
sets how many there are, `expert` gives a branch its structure, `top_k` says how many run per
sample.

## Integrations

- [Torch](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/torch/): `nn.Module`, sizes itself on the first
  forward pass, grafts into a model that already exists by submodule name.
- [Ultralytics YOLO](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/tutorial/): `esmoe.equip("yolo11n.yaml")`
  registers the block, grafts it into the config, renumbers layer references and wires the loss.
- [TensorFlow](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/tensorflow/): `tf.Module`, traces into
  `tf.function`, differentiated by a `GradientTape`.
- [Jax](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/jax/): pure `init` and `apply` over a parameter tree,
  under `jax.jit` and `jax.grad`.
- [Flax](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/flax/): `nnx.Module`, and a Linen variant under
  `esmoe.flax.linen`.
- [Keras 3](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/keras/): `keras.layers.Layer` on tensorflow, jax or
  torch, with the balancing term through `add_loss`.

## Reference

- [API](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/API/): every argument and entry point.
- [Design](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/design/): what the block computes, how the package
  is layered, what a new backend has to write.
- [Experiments](https://lfan-ke.github.io/ES-MoE/en/experiments/): how the defaults were chosen,
  with per-seed figures.
- [Source](https://github.com/Lfan-ke/ES-MoE) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/esmoe/)
